question: Kathakali took shape in Southern India in the seventeenth century under the patronage of the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prince of Karnataka.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kathakali** is a** classical dance-drama** form that originated in the state of** Kerala** in** Southern India** in the **seventeenth century.**
 
• It was developed under the** patronage** of the **Prince of Karnataka**, who was a **great patron **of the **arts and literature.**
 
• The Prince of Karnataka was a great admirer of the** traditional dance and theatre** forms of Kerala.
 
• He encouraged the artists to develop a new form o**f dance-drama **that would be more** vibrant and expressive.**
 
• The artists of Kerala, under the guidance of the Prince of Karnataka, developed** Kathakali**, which combines elements of **dance, music, drama, and ritual.**
 
• **Option 3**, Prince of Karnataka, is the **correct answer** as he was the patron of the art form.
